## Unpacking representation bias, one simulation at a time

Electoral institutions are difficult to study causally with observational data: they are jointly determined, endogenous, and rarely vary independently of one another. The REPBIAS simulation app addresses this by generating large numbers of synthetic polities in which four institutional parameters — **malapportionment**, **district magnitude**, the **seat-allocation formula**, and the **legal electoral threshold** — are introduced exogenously and independently of each other, decomposing total representation bias into the distinct share contributed by each one.

Use the controls inside the app below to set your own combination of institutions and see how the distortion — and its sources — change in real time.

:::
